candidates.excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao congratulated Kaiteki Innovations founder Raghu Duth Degala on the Hyderabad startup’s recognition at Vande Bharatam 2026. The company won the Disability Special Category Award for its GUKO Bidet assistive technology innovation.

candidates.title: Brazil's Amazon deforestation hits record low: Why it matters amid election battle
candidates.excerpt: Brazil's Amazon rainforest has achieved a remarkable milestone, showing its lowest annual deforestation at just 3,335 square kilometres, dropping by 41.8 percent from last year's figure of 5,731 square kilometres. President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's ambitious goal to halt illegal logging by 2030 underscores a strong political commitment to preserve this vital ecosystem, which plays a crucial role in climate stability and global environmental health.

candidates.title: Delhi Police arrest CJP’s Abhijeet Dipke; to be produced before court
candidates.excerpt: All India Students' Association (AISA) Neha Bora was also detained near Mandi House as police tightened security across the heart of Delhi. She was released briefly after her detention.
